title: France: Clashes break out as protests go nationwide
summary: Police and elite security forces are out in force in French cities as tens of thousands participate in a new round of protests. The situation is slowing turning tense in some cities like Paris and…

image.caption: Clashes broke out between police and protesters at the end of protests in MarseilleImage: Manon Cruz/REUTERS

blocks.text: At least 400,000 people have taken part in protests across France

blocks.caption: Protests were approved in Paris and Marseille but not in other cities (Photo: Marseille)Image: Manon Cruz/REUTERS

blocks.text: The French interior ministry said it estimates 410,000 people to have taken part in protest throughout France today.
Demonstrations were set to take place in Paris and Marseille but protesters took to the streets in other cities for rallies like Lyon and Nantes.
There were reports about clashes between protesters and police in several cities, including Paris.
There were protests in the city of Lyon, in the east-central part of France, where police used tear gas to disperse protesters wearing masks.
There are also reports about clashes in Marseille, where police fired tear gas to disperse crowds.
About 550,000 people attended demonstrations throughout the country last weekend.
